subject: Renewal: payor delegation + capacity add-on — invoicing path and net terms
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@novapoint.com>, accounts-payable@novapoint.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: payor delegation + capacity add-on — invoicing path and net terms

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. Per our call, Novapoint is moving forward with the 12‑month renewal (baseline commit) plus the immediate capacity top‑up (+300k tokens/month) for Q3. To keep billing and procurement clean on your side, you mentioned Accounts Payable will issue a PO for the committed renewal and a separate PO for the top‑up usage.

Two quick asks to get us set up:
- Can you confirm the PO numbers (or that AP will email them) and the exact payor entity names you want on each invoice? We can split invoices between two payor entities if needed.
- We need a W‑9 (or equivalent tax form) from the invoicing entity on file before we can finalize the invoice routing.
- For cashflow planning: can Novapoint accept Net45 on the renewal invoices? If not, tell me the preferred net terms and we’ll align.

I attached the latest SOW (SOW_Novapoint_Redwood_v2.pdf) for reference. Once we have the PO(s) and W‑9, Marcus will create the billing lanes and Jordan will coordinate the contract amendment (term + addendum for top‑up).

Goal: have invoice routing and payor split set up before the renewal effective date (2027‑06‑01).

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
[Attachment: SOW_Novapoint_Redwood_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@novapoint.com>

Date: 2027-05-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: payor delegation + capacity add-on — invoicing path and net terms

Hi Priya —

Thanks — confirmed. AP will issue two POs as discussed:
- PO# NOV-8421‑COM for the 12‑month commitment (Novapoint, Inc.)
- PO# NOV-8421‑TOP for the capacity top‑up (Novapoint Services LLC)

I attached the signed PO for the commitment (PO-8421-Commitment.pdf) and a current W‑9 for Novapoint, Inc. (Novapoint_W9.pdf). AP said they will send the separate PO for the top‑up by end of day tomorrow.

Net terms: finance prefers Net30 by default; for this renewal they can accept Net45 only if Redwood can split the invoices by entity exactly as above.

Please let me know what you need from legal or if you require any entity IDs for tax.

Best,
Maria Gutierrez
Director, Procurement Operations
Novapoint

Marcus / Jordan —

Forwarding Novapoint's PO + W‑9. Action items:
1) Marcus: please create two payor lanes in the billing system:
   - "Novapoint, Inc." (PO NOV-8421-COM) — set Net45 per Maria's note (they will accept Net45 only if split is enforced).
   - "Novapoint Services LLC" (PO NOV-8421-TOP once received) — default Net30.
   Assign the renewal subscription to the first lane and route any usage above commit to the second lane for the top‑up PO. Confirm how this will appear on invoices (separate invoice docs vs. single invoice with two line payees).
2) Jordan: please prepare the amendment (term start 2027‑06‑01, SOW v2 attached) and include a billing clause that invoices for the commit go to Novapoint, Inc. and top‑up invoices go to Novapoint Services LLC. Legal can sign; we just need the billing routing language to match Marcus' lanes.
3) All: once Marcus has lanes created, Priya will confirm to Novapoint and request the second PO.

Timing: Marcus, can you confirm lanes by COB 2027‑05‑11?

Thanks —
Priya
